SELECT fish_date_season AS season, CAST(fish_date_doy/30 AS INT) AS month_bucket,
       cls, COUNT(*) AS n_trips, SUM(anglers) AS anglers, SUM(yt) AS yt,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) AS yt_per_angler
FROM trips
GROUP BY 1,2,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT landing, boat, cls, COUNT(*) n, SUM(anglers) anglers, SUM(yt) yt,
       ROUND(SUM(yt)*1.0/NULLIF(SUM(anglers),0),3) ypa
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season=1 AND fish_date_doy BETWEEN 290 AND 330
  AND cls IN ('day_1_5','overnight')
GROUP BY 1,2,3
HAVING SUM(anglers) > 20
ORDER BY ypa DESC
LIMIT 15
